published.citation: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 247985094: Teff: 3345 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=IV/39/tic82

temperature.note: The Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 23317+1956 WIR 1 AB: 5.2 arcsec apart, magnitudes 10.52 and 12.4: the companion gives 15.0% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
